title: Mystery Man in Church
content: Sketch of a man in church, byGiovanni Boldini(1842-1931)Boldini painted a man near him in church. Who is that man?Boldini Portrait of Sem (Georges Gourçat)According toChristies, "it could represent the caricaturist Georges Gourçat, known as Sem (1863-1934), who was a good friend of Boldini."
